# Spec fixtures for Subphase 2.9 (Independent Tester)

Written from the 2.9 brief and PLAN Appendix A alone (black box).

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `clean/`, `trap/`, `gap/`, `hidden/` | Bundles (directory form): `table.toml` + `playfield.glb` generated by `pin_tablegen` from `src/`, plus `rules.lua` (= `scripts/clean.lua`), `backglass.toml` and the placeholder scene file `frenzy_scene.toml`. |
| `src/<geo>_layout.toml`, `src/<geo>_base.toml` | Generator inputs. Regenerate with `cargo run -p pin_tablegen -- src/<geo>_layout.toml --table src/<geo>_base.toml --out <geo>` (then delete `<geo>/.tablegen-lock` and copy the three hand-written files back). |
| `scripts/*.lua` | Rules variants; tests copy a geometry to a temp dir and swap `rules.lua` (`support.rs::variant`). |
| `support.rs` | Plain-`Simulation` helpers and fixture paths. |
| `soak_support.rs` | Helpers over the brief's `pin_sim::autoplay` API. |

## Clean table

514 x 1070 mm, pitch 6.5 deg, closed outer wall (`walls[0]`), inlane guides
(`walls[1..2]`) onto two 76 mm flippers at y = 150 mm, a drain funnel
(`walls[3..4]`) into `trough_1` (r 55 mm at (257, 30)). Dispenser `feed`
serves every ball down the centre: through `top_opto` (y 850) then `mid_opto`
(y 740) — shot `orbit_shot`, window 2000 ms — onto bumper `bumper_1`
(y 640), whose first ring hit of a game starts mode `frenzy`
(`show_scene(scene_frenzy)`). `scripts/clean.lua`: `start` begins a 3-ball
game (auto-serve), each `trough_1` edge ends a ball; persist keys
`game_state`, `ball_ticks`, `games_done`, `balls_served` expose the game to
tests. The rules also increment the persist key `mode:frenzy` (declared last in each
table) when the mode starts, the soak's mode-start signal (DECISIONS "2.9 — mode-start signal"); `mode_error.lua` errors first and does not. Declared switches: `top_opto`, `mid_opto`, `trough_1`,
`lower_left_eos`, `lower_right_eos`, `bumper_1_ring`.

## Planted defects

| Bundle | Defect | Expected finding |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `trap/` | `walls[5]`: a U pocket open at the top under the serve; every served ball rests at (255, 893.5) mm | StuckBall naming the pocket (`walls[5]` or a position near it) |
| `gap/` | `walls[0]` open between the funnel walls at y = 0; `trough_1` moved to the top-left corner | EscapedBall |
| `hidden/` | `hidden_opto` inside the closed box `walls[5]` | UnreachableSwitch `hidden_opto` |
| clean + `scripts/mode_error.lua` | `error(...)` when mode `frenzy` starts | ScriptError, ModeCoverage `frenzy` |
| clean + `scripts/flood.lua` | 40 coil pulses per 500 ticks (queue holds 32) | QueueOverflow |
| clean + `impossible_shot` | `mid_opto` then `top_opto` within 1 ms | ShotCoverage `impossible_shot` |

## Detector scripts

`rest.lua` (trap geometry: a ball at rest in the pocket from tick 1),
`cradle.lua` (left flipper coil held, a ball settles on it), `trough_rest.lua`
(a ball at rest in the trough zone), `fly.lua` (a ball thrown over the left
wall), `launch.lua` (as clean, but each ball waits for `launch`),
`inert.lua` (nothing). `spec_2_9_fixtures.rs` checks every one of these with
the plain `Simulation` API.
